text: Carapaz seized the Alpine queen stage in a dramatic finale on Alpe d'Huez, but the real story was Kuss's collapse—two crashes and a loss of composure that handed the breakaway's best shot at toppling Pogačar back to the yellow jersey wearer. Pogačar dispatched Seixas with a decisive acceleration in the GC group and brought Del Toro home just over a minute back, cementing his grip on the lead while Evenepoel's scrappy second-place effort narrowed the gap only marginally. With one mountain stage left, the break riders' failure to coordinate proved fatal; Pogačar, once again, turned chaos into control.
